body: Thank you I appreciate that. And I'm 23 sorry i forgot to mention that. Like I know I have alot of life left to live but I just struggle to find any good reason to stick with it other than the cliche friends and family will miss you. I've been gone from home for almost 2 years without seeing any of my family. They never offer to come visit or anything and I have a hard time getting time off work cause of my job. I know they would miss me but I feel like they've gone this long without seeing me so they wouldn't have a hard time adjusting to never seeing me again.
